correctness.rationale: Four profile transfer recurrence (a,u,c,v)→(2tu+c,ta+v,a,u) follows by covering each column and retaining right protrusions. Alternating signs produce the two-column M_-=[[-1,2],[-1,1]] with M_-²=−I, so W_m(b*)=(-1)^ceil(m/2). Unsigned M_+=[[3,2],[1,1]] has trace 4, determinant 1, giving odd A_m=4A_{m-1}-A_{m-2}. All signs W=A_m−2N are odd, and explicit unit value proves sharp min 1; group Walsh diagonalization gives inverse norm 1 and condition A_m. Independent perfect-matching enumeration m=1..4 and all-character spectrum for m=1,2 corroborate.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The two do not directly imply sharp ±1 for a uniform alternating-column signing at every width without the special four-state matrix identity.
